project_name: PUI89 Sentinel — All-Terrain Exploration & Inspection Robot
intended_use: Optional geometry context for inspection positioning and scene documentation only.
planned_spatial_tasks: Geometry evidence kept separate from non-spatial sensor and mission evidence
limitations_and_safety_boundaries: Geometry and spatial perception cannot determine chemical composition or certify atmospheric safety.
Do not enter confined or potentially hazardous areas based on RGB, depth or LiDAR alone; use site-authorised procedures and calibrated instruments when required by the risk assessment.
Inspection observations are advisory and require human review.
evidence_status: No real sensor integration, locomotion performance, field validation or certification claimed.
cost_policy: standard-library-first; no paid APIs, cloud GPU, model downloads or hardware purchases
